PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.introduction: This privacy policy describes the currently planned data processing on the website. Before publication, it must be adapted to the actual hosting, email services, and any other services that are used.

warning.title: Development Template
warning.description: The information regarding the controller, hosting provider, retention periods, recipients, and supervisory authority must be confirmed before publication.

controller.title: 1. Data Controller
controller.description: The controller within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is:
controller.missing: INSERT FULL LEGAL NAME AND ADDRESS

general.title: 2. General Information on Data Processing
general.description: Personal data is processed only to the extent necessary to provide the website, respond to inquiries, or fulfill legal obligations.
general.legalBasis: The applicable legal basis depends on the purpose of the processing and is described in the following sections.

hosting.title: 3. Hosting and Server Log Files
hosting.description: When visiting the website, the hosting provider may process technically necessary data, including the IP address, date and time of access, requested resource, amount of data transferred, referrer, browser, and operating system.
hosting.purpose: The processing serves the secure and technically stable operation of the website as well as error detection and abuse prevention.
hosting.providerMissing: INSERT HOSTING PROVIDER AND CONTRACT DETAILS
hosting.retention: The specific retention period of the server log files must be confirmed with the hosting provider and documented here.
hosting.legalBasis: The legal basis may in particular be Article 6(1)(f) GDPR; the final assessment depends on the actual technical configuration.

contact.title: 4. Contact by Email, Telephone, and Contact Form
contact.description: If you contact us, we process the information you provide in order to respond to your inquiry and communicate with you.
contact.data: Depending on the contact method, this may include your name, email address, telephone number, selected service, and the content of your message.
contact.legalBasis: If the inquiry relates to the conclusion or performance of a contract, Article 6(1)(b) GDPR may apply. In other cases, processing may be based on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
contact.retention: The data will be deleted once it is no longer required to process the inquiry and statutory retention obligations have expired.
contact.emailStatusDisabled: The contact form email function is currently not enabled.
contact.emailStatusEnabled: The contact form email function is enabled. The provider, recipients, transmission methods, and legal basis must be documented here.

consent.title: 5. Consent Notice for the Contact Form
consent.description: Consent must be voluntary, informed, specific, and revocable. Before going live, it should be determined whether the contact form relies on consent or another legal basis.
consent.withdrawal: Any consent given may be withdrawn with effect for the future. The lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal remains unaffected.

maps.title: 6. Google Maps
maps.externalLink: This website currently does not automatically load an embedded Google Maps map. Only an external link to Google Maps is provided.
maps.externalEffect: Only when you click the link will you leave this website, and Google may process your data according to its own policies.
maps.embeddedWarning: If an embedded map is introduced later, consent management, international data transfers, and privacy information must be reviewed again.

fonts.title: 7. Fonts
fonts.description: Fonts integrated using next/font are provided locally during the build process and are not loaded directly from Google servers when visiting the website.

cookies.title: 8. Cookies and Access to End Devices
cookies.description: The current version of the website does not use analytics or marketing cookies.
cookies.necessary: Technically necessary storage or access may be permitted without consent. Any non-essential storage or access generally requires prior valid consent.
cookies.future: If analytics, marketing, video, maps, or other third-party services are added later, this section must be updated and, where required, a consent banner must be implemented.

recipients.title: 9. Recipients and Data Processors
recipients.description: Personal data may be shared with service providers responsible for hosting, email delivery, or technical maintenance.

transfers.title: 10. International Data Transfers
transfers.description: Whether data is processed outside the European Economic Area depends on the service providers actually used and their configuration.

rights.title: 11. Rights of Data Subjects
rights.description: Subject to the legal requirements, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, data portability, and object to processing.
rights.consent: Where processing is based on consent, that consent may be withdrawn for the future.

complaint.title: 12. Right to Lodge a Complaint
complaint.description: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection supervisory authority.
